name: Recall Ranking and Provenance
description: Recall returns ranked results with provenance: source, timestamp, confidence, and relationship to query. Ranking is based on relevance, recency, confidence, and source authority.
purpose: Provide high-quality, explainable recall results by ranking memories with provenance metadata — enabling users and systems to trust and verify the results they receive.
acceptanceCriteria: Provenance data: source agent, timestamp, confidence, query relevance
Ranking factors: relevance, recency, confidence, source authority
Recall supports pagination with stable ordering
Provenance is verifiable — source can be traced to original remember operation
rollback_strategy: Restore default ranking weights; rebuild provenance index
recovery_strategy: Rebuild ranking index from stored memory metadata
